gloss: on border of Egypt, probably east branch of Nile
definition: שִׁיחוֺר proper name, of a river on border of Egypt, probably east branch of Nile ; — ׳ הַשּׁ Josh 13:3 , מִצְרַיִם ׳ שׁ 1Chr 13:5 clearly = Nile, זֶרַע שִׁחֹר Isa 23:3 (|| יְאוֺר קְצִיר ), מֵי שִׁחוֺר Jer 2:18 compare Dl Pa 311 Wilson Hast. DB SHIHOR (usually derived from I. שׁחר , as black water , but doubtful).
